title: Sparkly spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='topGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff2e63'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1fa8e0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='coneGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f5a623'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- spinning motion arcs -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q16 40 28 34' fill='none' stroke='#8ef0ff' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 52 Q84 40 72 34' fill='none' stroke='#8ef0ff' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 66 Q18 62 24 57' fill='none' stroke='#b9f7ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 66 Q82 62 76 57' fill='none' stroke='#b9f7ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- knob on top -->
  <rect x='46' y='16' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='4.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>

  <!-- top body -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q30 26 50 26 Q70 26 70 34 L70 42 Q70 56 50 62 Q30 56 30 42 Z' fill='url(#topGrad)'/>

  <!-- colour band -->
  <path d='M31 40 L69 40 L69 47 L31 47 Z' fill='url(#bandGrad)'/>

  <!-- swirl stripes -->
  <path d='M36 33 Q43 30 50 33 Q57 36 64 33' fill='none' stroke='#ffd1dc' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 51 Q40 55 44 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffd1dc' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 52 Q60 55 66 51' fill='none' stroke='#ffd1dc' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- cone tip -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 66 58 60 L53 80 Q50 86 47 80 Z' fill='url(#coneGrad)'/>
  <path d='M50 70 L50 82' stroke='#c97d10' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='3.2' fill='#c97d10'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7a8'>
    <path d='M18 26 L20.5 31 L26 26 L20.5 21 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 22 L82 26.5 L86.5 22 L82 17.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M14 74 L16 78 L20 74 L16 70 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 78 L86 82 L90 78 L86 74 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#b6f5ff'>
    <path d='M32 14 L33.5 17 L36.5 14 L33.5 11 Z'/>
    <path d='M68 88 L70 91.5 L73 88 L70 84.5 Z'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='44' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='48' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='88' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='10' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
